subject.title: Feature/Fix: Integrate lineage discovery and shadow accounting

question: After exact-head runtime proof is added, is the extra bounded filesystem and JSONL work during changed Codex refreshes acceptable for non-authoritative shadow diagnostics?
rationale: Tests establish accounting logic, but maintainer intent is required to accept production refresh latency and cancellation costs for an experimental shadow path.

options.title: Accept after exact-head proof
options.body: Merge after the prerequisite lands and redacted exact-head logs demonstrate bounded cold, changed, unchanged/repeated, and cancellation behavior.

options.title: Require a cheaper trigger
options.body: Keep the PR open until shadow execution is sampled, explicitly opt-in, or derived from cached parse evidence.

options.title: Defer shadow integration
options.body: Land only the ledger foundation and postpone production-refresh integration until lineage accounting is closer to promotion.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Merge after the prerequisite lands and redacted exact-head logs demonstrate bounded cold, changed, unchanged/repeated, and cancellation behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the clearest available decision owner for production scanner architecture and release-time availability tradeoffs.
